notes.title: Release Date
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce that my RTS/Puzzle/Arcade-Mash-Up Game Psychoballs will be released on March, 10th on Steam for only USD 0.59$ (!!! / 0.99$ + 40% Launch Discount).

The game also comes with a custom Level Editor, so you can create your own puzzles / levels if you like and I will add the soundtrack as free DLC later on.
